slides.title: How long does emptying the dishwasher take? (You're wrong.)
Time blindness makes chores huge
slides.body: Our brain guesses 'forever', so we avoid it. Most people who time it find it's under 5 minutes.

slides.title: Chores I timed (your times will differ)
Time your own chores once
slides.body: Use a stopwatch, write the time on a sticky note, put it where you do the chore. Now your brain has real data.

slides.title: Use 'while' moments
slides.body: Coffee brewing = wipe a counter. Microwave running = put 5 things away. Waiting time is free time.

slides.title: Use a visual timer
slides.body: Seeing time shrink helps more than a number on a phone. Put one in the kitchen.

slides.title: The dread lasted 3 days. The chore took 4 minutes.
Stop guessing, start resetting
slides.body: The Messy Brain Home Reset has a 7-day plan with every task sized to under 15 minutes. Link in bio.
